scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏中物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: [Cotton]
Well, you look to weak to work. I don't think you can do it right now.
scripts.translation: 你看起来太弱了，恐怕现在还干不了这份活。

scripts.text: - This quest is for level 150 or higher -
scripts.translation: - 此任务需要达到150级或以上 -

scripts.text: - I've met eyes with the automatic doll in front of the farming facility. -
scripts.translation: - 我和农业设施前的人偶对上了视线。-

scripts.text: - The doll looked at me up and down, and turn its head. -
scripts.translation: - 人偶上下打量了我一番，然后转过头去。-

scripts.text: - I've met eyes with the automatic doll in front of the farming facility. -
scripts.translation: - 我和农业设施前的人偶对上了视线。-

scripts.text: [Automatic Doll]
Heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature is all normal.
scripts.translation: 心率、血压和体温均正常。

scripts.text: Breathing is normal. Eyes stability normal.
scripts.translation: 呼吸正常。眼球稳定性正常。

scripts.text: Checking registration information...
- The doll looked at me up and down, and as if she look satisfied. -
scripts.translation: - 人偶上下打量了我一番，似乎很满意。-

scripts.text: [Automatic Doll]
Hello, {0}?
Did you come to see farming facility?
scripts.translation: 你是来参观农业设施的吗？

scripts.text: Huh.
No.
[Automatic Doll]
This is the farming facility, where Kitty and the others live.
scripts.translation: 这里是农业设施，小猫咪和其他伙伴都住在这里。

scripts.text: Just talk to me, if you're interested.
scripts.translation: 感兴趣的话，直接问我就好。

scripts.text: I will explain everything to you.
[Automatic Doll]
Kitty, hold still for a minute. Good boy~
scripts.translation: 小猫咪，乖乖待一会儿。真乖~

scripts.text: I am in charge of the farm facility here.
scripts.translation: 我负责这里的农业设施。

scripts.text: I fix the plants, give it fertilizer and feed kitty here and his friends.
scripts.translation: 我照料植物、给它们施肥，也喂养这里的小猫咪和它的朋友们。

scripts.text: [Automatic Doll]
The ingredients for the dessert that comes out from the cafeteria is harvested here.
scripts.translation: 食堂甜点所需的食材就是在这里收获的。

scripts.text: Ehem.
[Automatic Doll]
There have been a lot of guests lately, so we've been given more orders to harvest.
scripts.translation: 最近客人很多，所以采收的订单也增加了。

scripts.text: My colleague from an another job has just been assigned to this place, but she's a little clumsy.
scripts.translation: 我有位刚从其他岗位调来的同事，不过她有点笨手笨脚。

scripts.text: It's easy to get a good harvest when everyone listens.
scripts.translation: 只要大家听话，收成就会很好。

scripts.text: You're talkative.
[Luina]
Oh, I forgot that I should introduce myself first, if I wanted to talk to a guest for a long time.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，要和客人聊这么久，我居然忘了先自我介绍。

scripts.text: My name is Luina.
[Luina]
Kitty here is a plant called a Pitaya. It's an improved ancient species that lived somewhere on this island.
scripts.translation: 小猫咪是一种叫火龙果的植物，是这座岛上某种古老物种改良而来的。

scripts.text: I don't know if it's weird, but I'm not a Pitaya, but I'm good at listening.
scripts.translation: 不知道是不是很奇怪，明明我不是火龙果，它们却很听我的话。

scripts.text: - Luina stroked the Pitaya. -
[Luina]
My master told me, I should name cute little things.
scripts.translation: 主人告诉我，应该给可爱的小东西起名字。

scripts.text: Kitty, Butterfly, Happy, and so on.
scripts.translation: 比如小猫咪、蝴蝶、快乐之类的。

scripts.text: Pitaya is a small and cute creature, so I gave them a name.
scripts.translation: 火龙果又小又可爱，所以我给它们起了名字。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Kitty is the cutest, the pitaya over here is Kitty.
scripts.translation: 小猫咪最可爱了，这边这只火龙果就是小猫咪。

scripts.text: [Luina]
So...
Are you here to cut off some tails?
Tail?
I don't have a tail.
[Luina]
You're here to cut off some tails, aren't you?
Oh, I've made a mistake.
Hold on for a while. I'll process the explanation.
scripts.translation: 请稍等一下，我整理一下说明。

scripts.text: [Luina]
If you look at Kitty right now, He doesn't have roots, right?
scripts.translation: 你看现在的小猫咪，它没有根，对吧？

scripts.text: It absorbs moisture from the air and photosyntheses it even without the roots.
scripts.translation: 即使没有根，它也能从空气中吸收水分并进行光合作用。

scripts.text: Just some fertilizer... and some foods.
scripts.translation: 只需要一些肥料...还有食物。

scripts.text: [Luina]
When you plant the seeds, they grow out of the ground, but I've never seen a multiple sprout before.
scripts.translation: 种下种子后，它们会从土里长出来，但我从没见过一次长出多株的情况。

scripts.text: [Luina]
For the tail, You just grab the Pitaya, stroke it like this, and let them go.
scripts.translation: 至于尾巴，只要抓住火龙果，像这样抚摸它，然后放开就行。

scripts.text: - Luina held the Pitaya, demo to on how to pull the tail and put it down. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜抱起火龙果，示范如何取下尾巴，再把它放回去。-

scripts.text: [Luina]
No, no. I didn't pull it.
The harvested tail is not necessarily enough to eat.
scripts.translation: 采下来的尾巴不一定都能吃。

scripts.text: You have to take the loss into account.
[Luina]
You need to remove the seeds and the skin, but it's not difficult.
scripts.translation: 你需要去掉种子和果皮，不过并不难。

scripts.text: After processing it, the harvested Pitaya tail goes up to the table.
scripts.translation: 处理好后，采下的火龙果尾巴就可以上桌了。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Harvesting is actually a bit difficult, so my colleague, 'Silk', will guide you.
scripts.translation: 采收其实有点难，所以我的同事“丝绸”会来指导你。

scripts.text: You can enter even without a harvest. I'll just let you in here without a guide.
scripts.translation: 不参加采收也可以进去。只是参观的话，我可以直接放你进去。

scripts.text: [Luina]
If you're free, talk to 'Cotton' here, she's the play manager, and she'll let you know what to do.
scripts.translation: 有空的话，找这里负责活动的“棉花”聊聊，她会告诉你该做什么。

scripts.text: I know it's a little hard for you, but... if you lend us a hand, we will properly compensate you.
scripts.translation: 我知道这对你来说有点难...不过，如果你愿意帮忙，我们会好好酬谢你。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Now that you've heard the instructions, you can enter now.
scripts.translation: 既然你已经听完说明，现在可以进去了。

scripts.text: You can just go in if you want to look around.
scripts.translation: 想四处看看的话，直接进去就行。

scripts.text: [Luina]
We talked about Cotton's job first, but it's actually the harvest that's more urgent.
scripts.translation: 刚才先说了棉花的工作，不过眼下采收更紧急。

scripts.text: If you're confident in your combat skills, I'd like you to help with the harvest.
scripts.translation: 如果你对自己的战斗能力有信心，希望你能来帮忙采收。

scripts.text: I wish you can help me with the harvest...
We have to feed Boss Kitty also.
Boss Kitty?
[Luina]
I just call him that, He is a little different from the other, it's hiding in a place that's hard to see.
scripts.translation: 我只是这么叫它。它和其他火龙果有点不同，总躲在不容易发现的地方。

scripts.text: If you want to see him around, you'll have to sprink the food and make it a little noisy around the farm.
scripts.translation: 想见到它，就得在农场撒些食物，再闹出点动静。

scripts.text: [Luina]
I'm the one in charge of the harvest, so please talk to me anytime you want!
scripts.translation: 采收由我负责，想聊的时候随时来找我！

scripts.text: [Luina]
Let's talk about the details when you want to help.
scripts.translation: 你想帮忙时，我们再聊具体安排。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Did the younglings came to play with you?
scripts.translation: 小家伙们来找你玩了吗？

scripts.text: That's strange... I heard you very well.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪...我明明听得很清楚。

scripts.text: ... what? Even Silk?
What happened?
She is pretending to be a cat.
[Kitty]
Cluck.
-- The cat hid behind Luina before she reached it. --
scripts.translation: -- 猫在露伊娜碰到它之前就躲到了她身后。--

scripts.text: [Luina]
What...
[Luina]
Maybe... just maybe?
It's listening to me?
I guess.
[Luina]
Kitty.
[Luina]
Is this what the guests would say as 'embarassed'?
scripts.translation: 这就是客人们说的“害羞”吗？

scripts.text: - When Luina reached out her hand to the cat, it put it's heads up to her hand. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜向猫伸出手时，它把头靠在她的手上。-

scripts.text: - Luina's face became complex with a satisfied expression while petting the cat. -
scripts.translation: - 露伊娜抚摸着猫，脸上露出既复杂又满足的神情。-

scripts.text: [Luina]
Hmm...
Won't the guest will be able to befriend meow someday?
scripts.translation: 总有一天，客人也能和喵交上朋友吧？

scripts.text: [Luina]
Wouldn't it be great if we continued playing with them like this?
scripts.translation: 如果能一直这样和它们玩耍，那该多好啊。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Yes! Please help Silk again tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation: 是的！明天也请继续帮助丝绸。

scripts.text: Then, one day... You'll be able to befriend all of the Pitayas!
scripts.translation: 那么，总有一天...你就能和所有火龙果成为朋友了！

scripts.text: Here... it's a token of promise.
[Luina]
Probably.
- The cat cried with a high pitch sound as if it's excited. -
scripts.translation: - 猫兴奋地发出了高亢的叫声。-

scripts.text: [Luina]
We have completed the necessary harvest for today.
scripts.translation: 今天需要的收获已经完成了。

scripts.text: We will resume our harvest again by dawn. Come back by then.
scripts.translation: 我们会在黎明时恢复采收，到时候再来吧。

scripts.text: [Luina]
^0000FFOur struggle with the Pitaya seems like a long time ago.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF与火龙果的苦战仿佛已是很久以前的事。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000FFI now have the courage again to go back into the farming facility again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF我现在又有勇气回到农业设施了。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000You must organize for atleast one person or join a party to enter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000进入前必须组建至少一人的队伍，或加入其他队伍。^000000

scripts.text: [Luina]
!? What happened? You have a broken tail.
I'll take care of that, please.
Thank you.... After the next harvest experience, be sure to deliver it to Silk and come out.
scripts.translation: 谢谢...下次体验采收后，记得先把它交给丝绸再出来。

scripts.text: [Luina]
Hello, {0}.
Are you going to enter the farming facility today?
scripts.translation: 你今天要进入农业设施吗？

scripts.text: Enter the dungeon.
Cancel
[Luina]
Please wait for a moment~
I'll prepare the food for today.

[Big Meow]
Purr.
-- Big meow is taking a nap. --
